parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the member account in the resource folder. This parameter is used by the multi-account security management feature of Security Center to query the security information of specified member accounts.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.
